story:
Comprehensive Pain Specialists is an independent pain management practice at 1177 PA-315, Dolphin Plaza, in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. Our skilled professionals focus on identifying the root causes of pain and creating personalized treatment plans, with the goal of enhancing quality of life, alleviating discomfort, and improving mobility so patients can regain control of their daily activities.

We are a specialty practice, not a general clinic that also handles pain. That distinction shapes how a visit works here: the first appointment is spent locating the actual pain generator — a disc, a facet joint, the sacroiliac joint, a nerve root, or something outside the spine — rather than treating a symptom in the dark. From there, treatment draws on roughly forty interventional procedures performed in-practice, including spinal cord stimulation, radiofrequency ablation, epidural and facet joint injections, nerve blocks, Vertiflex, Intracept, the MILD procedure, prolotherapy, and trigger point injections.

Our providers are dedicated to delivering compassionate, individualized care, and all of our specially trained staff understand pain. When you arrive, our receptionists, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and doctors greet you with a supportive attitude so that your entire experience with us is as positive and comfortable as possible. We serve patients from Wilkes-Barre, Mountain Top, Pittston, Dallas, Plymouth, Glen Lyon, and the surrounding Wyoming Valley, and we are currently accepting new patients.
